mines.mine_notes: Underground polymetallic (VMS) mine, Guerrero state; 2,400 tpd flotation plant. FY2025: 700,152 t milled @ 1.49 g/t Au, 104.36 g/t Ag, 0.76% Pb, 3.15% Zn, 0.78% Cu; produced 8,735 oz Au, 1,010,710 oz Ag, 4,924 klb Pb, 38,740 klb Zn, 8,895 klb Cu (126,086 klb ZnEq). Sold: 5,619 oz Au, 736,775 oz Ag, 29,072 klb Zn, 7,038 klb Cu. Costs quoted per payable ZnEq lb (not per oz): cash cost $0.99/lb, AISC $1.24/lb. Sustaining capex $18.0M. Copper/lead separation optimization ongoing; first meaningful exploration in over a decade (5,000 m program).
mines.processing: Flotation (zinc, copper and bulk lead concentrates)

mines.mine_notes: Underground epithermal gold-silver mine, Durango state; 1,000 tpd plant. Declared commercial production March 31, 2025 (>800 tpd). FY2025: 311,629 t milled @ 2.10 g/t Au, 37.74 g/t Ag, 0.78% Pb, 1.40% Zn, 0.21% Cu (Au recovery 82.8%, Ag 83.6%); produced 17,410 oz Au, 316,166 oz Ag, 4,000 klb Pb, 6,472 klb Zn, 1,185 klb Cu (26,200 AuEq oz). Sold: 15,837 oz Au, 279,997 oz Ag, 3,370 klb Pb, 3,808 klb Zn (21,453 AuEq oz). Cash cost $2,176/AuEq oz sold; AISC $2,832/AuEq oz sold. Sustaining capex $9.2M. Silver stream: Empress Royalty receives 100% of first 1,250,000 payable oz Ag from lead/zinc concentrates (837,247 oz remaining at YE2025), then 20%; obligations terminate March 2033.

notes: FY2025 MD&A used (year ended December 31, 2025, filed April 7, 2026). Record annual revenue $176.8M; adjusted EBITDA $46.0M; net free cash flow before working capital $20.8M; cash $25.5M at YE2025; long-term debt reduced >80% to $3.3M. Consolidated produced: 26,144 oz Au (payable 21,456 oz sold), 1,326,877 oz Ag. No proven & probable mineral reserves disclosed in the MD&A (reserve fields null); company fact sheet cites M&I resources of 16.6 Mt (Campo Morado) and 6.3 Mt (Tahuehueto). Cash costs per ZnEq lb (Campo Morado) and per AuEq oz (Tahuehueto) are non-IFRS; not directly comparable to per-oz gold/silver AISC.
